finalText:
Found it: `src/jobs/processOrder.js:6` acquired a connection but only released it on the happy path, no `finally`. Every failed order left its connection stuck in `inUse` forever.

The worker log shows it exactly — order-4122 and 4123 fail validation, `pool in-use` climbs to 5/5 instead of dropping back, then the pool goes exhausted and `worker-1` gives up. The app log shows the same collapse on the API side, ending in the 2am restarts. `handleRequest` in `api.js` was already safe since it goes through `withConnection`'s try/finally — only the direct-acquire path in `processOrder` was leaking.

Fix: wrapped the `run(conn, order)` call in `processOrder` with try/finally so `pool.release(conn)` always runs. All 4 tests pass now.
